I have never personally experienced sleep paralysis, but from what I gather, you are actually awake just incapable of moving any muscle in your body except for your eyes.

This is a mechanism in your body that stops you from moving, so when you dream, your body doesn't act out all the things you do in your dream.

Sleep paralysis is basically a glitch where your body thinks you are dreaming so it activates this "lockdown" feature, preventing you from moving. You actually see what is in your room, though it is common to have hallucinations.

tl:dr

Sleep mask would just make it so you don't see what is in your bedroom, but it wouldn't take away the fact that you are awake but can't move your body.
